brand_subtitle: Good vibes. Real fruit. Better planet.
brand_p1: Hi! We are Fruity, a young brand with a very clear idea: making enjoying a good refreshing drink even more fun, natural and fruity.
brand_p2: We love what is authentic, fresh and tastes truly real. That is why we commit to home-grown fruit, caring for it from the very start and letting it ripen on the plant so it reaches its perfect point and we can squeeze out every last drop of its flavour. Because when the raw material is good, you can tell. And a lot!
brand_p3: But for us, it is not all about flavour. We also believe that enjoying what nature gives us means looking after it. We are a brand committed to the environment, choosing a more conscious way of producing that respects our surroundings.
brand_p4: We want to add a little more fruit to your everyday, bring colour to your plans and remind you that fun can be sustainable.
brand_p5: We are young, we are natural and above all we love to enjoy life! and we are eager to share it with you.🫶🏼
success_title: Good places. Good people. Fruity moments.
success_lead: Every place has its own story. From bars where something always happens to festivals where music changes everything. Discover how Fruity becomes part of new moments, new flavours and experiences to share.
s1_headline: A fresh twist on the classics.
s1_p1: In the heart of Girona we found La Cantonada, a friendly, laid-back bar where good moments always find their place.
s1_p2: Eager to give their drinks menu a fresh new look, they wanted to add options that were different, refreshing and had their own personality.
s1_p3: Fruity arrived to add a splash of colour to the offer, with flavours like Apple, Green Pear and Exotic Mix. An original alternative to go with vermouth, terrace afternoons and those get-togethers that always run a little longer than planned.
s1_p4: Because sometimes, to break the routine, all it takes is a new flavour.
s2_headline: Good music. Wild nights. Fresh drinks.
s2_p1: When night falls, Esbojarrats becomes one of those places where something is always happening. Music, lights, friends and an atmosphere that makes you forget about the clock.
s2_p2: They were looking for a drinks offer that matched their personality: bold, different and anything but conventional.
s2_p3: With Fruity they found exactly that. A selection of fruity, refreshing flavours that fits the energy of the venue and offers a different way to enjoy the night.
s2_p4: Between DJ sessions, endless conversations and impromptu dance floors, Fruity found its place at Esbojarrats.
s2_closing: Make it a night to remember.
s3_p1: In Platja d'Aro, amid music, summer and a desire to discover new things, Floreixent was born: a small festival dedicated to giving emerging artists visibility and creating a space where music and creativity take centre stage.
s3_p2: To support this first adventure, they were looking for brands that shared their young, fresh and label-free spirit.
s3_p3: Fruity joined the festival, bringing its flavours to the grounds and becoming part of the experience: from the first concerts to the last toasts at sunset.
s3_p4: A collaboration that celebrates emerging talent, local culture and all those moments that make a festival much more than music.
cta_text: Have a bar, an event or an idea worth sharing? Let's make something fruity happen.

community_p1: We support local events, community gardens and projects that share food and time with neighbours.
community_p2: Initiatives will be announced here as they get started.

product_name: Fruit Cider Variety Pack | 6 x 330ml (3 flavors)
description_p1: Introducing our Fruit Cider Variety Pack, a premium selection of six refreshing ciders crafted to delight your taste buds. This pack includes three distinct flavors: Green Pear, Sweet Apple, and Exotic Mix, each meticulously brewed to offer a unique and invigorating experience.
description_p2: Our ciders are proudly produced locally, ensuring that every sip supports local craftsmanship and reduces our carbon footprint. Made from the finest quality ingredients, our ciders are vegan-friendly. We believe in creating products that are not only delicious but also align with a sustainable lifestyle.
